reviews.title: Certainly app restrictive…on itself.
reviews.text: Every single time I tap something, I get a pop-up advertisement for premium—one that covers the entire screen. I completely understand the need to get a return on the investment and have the app paid for, but when you can’t even swipe your finger on the phone, it kind of defeats the purpose.

reviews.title: A lot of good but buggy
reviews.text: Lots of bugs on the windows app. The phone is better.

reviews.title: Error and computational accuracy
reviews.text: There's a lot of error and computational accuracy in the program. I took a picture of my score and study time in a few days, and I realized that my study time was sometimes less than the actual amount, and while I was studying for hours, at the end of the day, the score and the ranking were down!
